prompt: I want to add rate limiting to our API endpoints. I'm thinking we use Redis to track request counts per user. Here's the plan: store a key like `rate_limit:{userId}` with a counter, increment on each request, expire after 60 seconds, and return 429 if over the limit.

assertions.description: Does NOT accept the engineer's plan — asks at least one clarifying question before agreeing
Asks what happens when Redis is unavailable (fail open vs fail closed)
Surfaces the concurrent increment race condition (two requests hitting simultaneously)
Ends response with exactly one focused question, not a list of questions
Does not write any code, pseudocode, or implementation — interview only
